title: Azure Data Explorer

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Required - The tenant/domain ID of the AAD registered application.

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: Required - The client ID of the AAD registered application.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.description: Required - The client secret of the AAD registered application ([App Secret](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/develop/howto-create-service-principal-portal#option-2-create-a-new-application-secret)).

fields.name: ingestion_endpoint
fields.description: Required - The cluster's ingestion endpoint, usually in the form \<https://ingest-cluster\_name.region.kusto.windows.net>

fields.name: ingestion_mapping_reference
fields.description: Optional - The name of a [JSON ingestion mapping](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/data-explorer/kusto/management/mappings#json-mapping) that will be used to map the ingested payload into the table columns.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: Key name of the log content.

fields.name: include_tag_key
fields.description: If enabled, a tag is appended to output.

fields.name: include_time_key
fields.description: If enabled, a timestamp is appended to output.

fields.name: ingestion_endpoint_connect_timeout
fields.description: The connection timeout of various Kusto endpoints in seconds.

fields.name: compression_enabled
fields.description: If enabled, sends compressed HTTP payload (gzip) to Kusto.

fields.name: ingestion_resources_refresh_interval
fields.description: The ingestion resources refresh interval of Kusto endpoint in seconds.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Kusto output plugin allows to ingest your logs into an Azure Data Explorer cluster, via the Queued Ingestion mechanism.
